title: Prelude and Fugue in G major, BWV 541: Fugue

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 (3 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1 (3 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 and the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted and a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Returns in Episode 4 (bars 55–59).
sections.leads: From D major to G major; perfect cadence in D major at bar 17

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: the opening of countersubject 1 (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject (2 times) and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (2 times), in a sequence rising by a step every half bar. Bass: a figure from the subject.
sections.leads: From G major to E minor; perfect cadence in E minor at bar 35

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (9 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 (3 times) and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1 (3 times), in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (4 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and the opening of countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From E minor to D major

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 17–25) in part, with the soprano's line in the alto, a fourth higher. Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1. Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (3 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from the subject. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a fifth every bar.
sections.leads: From D major to A minor

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted and a figure from the subject. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1 and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a fourth every bar.
sections.leads: From A minor to G minor; perfect cadence in A minor at bar 63

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times). Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From G minor to G major
